name: Caster
description: Builds Arcane Charge through active Essence use and amplifies magic-adjacent effects.

focuses.name: Grand Channel
focuses.description: Overchannel affects your next 2 Essence abilities. The second ability receives 70% of the Overchannel bonus.

focuses.name: Safe Channel
focuses.description: Overchannel grants a Barrier equal to 10% Max Health for 8 seconds and interruption immunity for the Overchanneled ability. If the ability is still interrupted, refund 50 Focus.

focuses.name: Cataclysmic Release
focuses.description: Overchannel affects only one ability, but its potency bonus is doubled, capped at +24% Effect Potency. Overchannel cooldown +15 seconds and the empowered ability costs 20% more resource or cooldown.

coreMechanic: Gain Arcane Charge from active Essence abilities. At 5 Charge, empower the next eligible active effect.

skillTreeNodes.name: Arcane Armament
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DamageTypeConversion + ScalingConversion. Eligible hostile Physical Melee Essence abilities deal Magical damage instead of Physical damage. Converted abilities scale from Spell Power instead of Attack Power, retain the Melee tag, gain the Spell tag, cannot benefit from Physical penetration, and benefit from Magical penetration at 70% value. Resource cost +8%. If the ability was already Magical, it gains +5% Effect Potency instead.

skillTreeNodes.name: Elemental Thesis
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DamageTypeConversion. Choose one Elemental Thesis outside combat: Fire, Frost, Lightning, Earth, Poison, Holy, or Shadow. Eligible hostile Essence abilities convert their damage type to the chosen element. Converted abilities lose 10% base Effect Potency but benefit from elemental bonuses, resistance penetration, and elemental synergies. True damage cannot be converted. Non-hostile Essence abilities instead grant 4% resistance to the chosen element for 5 seconds.

skillTreeNodes.name: Ritual Formula
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: SummonConversion + DeliveryConversion. Summon, Aura, DamageOverTime, HealOverTime, and Persistent Essence effects gain the Spell tag.
